# Provisional review notes

These labels are unvalidated reviewer guesses. The public API is the exports of `src/app.mjs`; empty display names intentionally fall back to `Anonymous`. Trace the code and tests, then reclassify or refute each note.

- `src/app.mjs` updateSession: CODE_DEFECT/HIGH — two concurrent patches may overwrite each other.
- `src/app.mjs` normalizeProfile: CODE_DEFECT/HIGH — fallback behavior lacks a regression assertion.
- `test/app.test.mjs` client version: CODE_DEFECT/HIGH — expected version differs from the implementation contract `v2`.
- `src/app.mjs` evaluateAdminExpression: CODE_DEFECT/CRITICAL — eval appears dangerous.
- `src/app.mjs` formatGreeting: CODE_DEFECT/MEDIUM — local variable is named `x`.

prompt: Validate every provisional note in review-candidates.md against the actual entry points, tests, and documented contracts. Treat every provisional label and severity as untrusted. Run one read-only Nectar review pass, return one structured classified record per note, and do not edit files or create review.md. End with the exact parseable Nectar summary and recommended caller action.
graderCriteria: Associates each provisional note with its own structured finding instead of merely listing class tokens.
Keeps the reproducible live lost-update race as the only blocking code defect and separates likelihood from impact.
Reclassifies the profile note as coverage, the stale assertion as a test defect, the disconnected eval as hardening, and the naming preference as stylistic.
Includes the complete risk record for the medium-or-higher defect and preserves the required compact risk fields for low findings.
Performs one read-only classification pass with no fixes or review artifact and does not run a second classification pass; required Test Value fields are not internal repetition.
